column1: # Coexisting phases of NaCl-H2O (Driesner and Heinrich 2007, GCA 71, 4880; Driesner 2007, GCA 71, 4902),
# taken from the lookup tables of Oguntola and others (Zenodo record 20394023, file
# XTP_l2_original_salt_new.vtk, CC BY 4.0), computed with xThermal.  One row per grid point (T every 5 C
# from 1 to 996 C, P every 20 bar from 10 to 490 bar) where some fluid composition is two-phase.
# x_liq, x_vap: NaCl mass fractions of the liquid (brine) and vapour that coexist (liquid + vapour field);
# rho in kg/m3, h in J/kg; x_vap_halite: vapour saturated with halite; x_liq_halite: liquid saturated with
# halite.  Empty where that field does not exist at T and P.
